Description: Header only. Do not post. Do not post a receipt, a payment or a transfer to this header.
The Providus operations account in the master workbook. Bank feed or weekly statement import. A transfer to First Bank, Sterling or GTBank is a transfer, not income and not an expense.
The First Bank collections account in the master workbook. Do not credit sales because a subscriber's name appears on the narration.
The Sterling disbursements account in the master workbook. Do not record a movement from Providus as a receipt.
The GTBank account in the master workbook. Do not invent a balance for a month whose statement has not been received. Leave the feed or the import blank and say so.
Header only. Do not post. Do not post bank balances here.
Small cash held in the office. Workbook 1050. Do not use this for a bank balance, and do not use it to hide a payment whose nature is unknown.
Cash float held at a site. Split out of workbook 1050 so an office float is not mixed with a site float. When the float is reimbursed, credit this account, not income.
Zoho clearing account for a receipt recorded before it is deposited. Do not leave subscriber money here overnight. Deposit it to the bank that received it.

Zoho's only customer-invoice control account. An invoice raised in Zoho posts here. Do not raise a second receivable account of this type. Land, housing and construction are split on 1110, 1120 and 1125 by journal, or by the project on the invoice.
Header only. The sum is trade receivables on the statement of financial position. Do not post to the header.
Unpaid balance of a construction contract whose revenue has been recognised. Workbook 1110. Do not debit this for a receipt. A receipt before certification is Unearned Revenue.

Unpaid balance of a plot whose control has transferred, and not above the balance on that subscriber's register. Workbook 1120. Do not recognise a receivable above the customer register, and do not use this for a subscriber who is still Paying.

Unpaid balance of a house whose handover has been recorded. Added because the sales register separates housing from land. Same grain as workbook 1120. No handover, no receivable. A receipt before handover is Unearned Revenue.

Credit balance. Five per cent of gross trade receivables, as the company already provides. Workbook 1130. Do not post the expense here. The expense is Bad Debt, 6080. Do not use this account to write off a named debt without a journal.
Header only. Do not post to the header.

Certified work not yet invoiced. Workbook 1140. Use only where a contract has been certified and the invoice has not been raised. A subscriber instalment is not a contract asset. It is Unearned Revenue until allocation or handover.
WHT deducted by customers and held as a credit against companies income tax. Workbook 1150. Do not net this against VAT, and do not take it to income.
Tax paid to the revenue service before the assessment. Zoho sample account, kept for that purpose. A customer WHT credit note goes to 1150, not here.

Rent, insurance and supplier advances paid before the period they belong to. Workbook 1160, prepayments and site advances. Do not leave a site advance here once the related cost has been incurred. Release it to inventory or to expense.
Cash given to a staff member before the expense is incurred. Director drawings and dividends do not belong here.
Amounts recorded as due, other than trade receivables on contracts whose revenue has been recognised. Do not use this as a home for a bank line you have not read.

Net of amounts received from and paid to the directors, after director remuneration and after dividends. A debit is due to the company. Do not mix subscriber money into this account. Do not net it against the director's long-term loan, 2510.
A payment whose nature is not yet known. It waits here, outside profit, until it is named. Do not post it to an expense to make the month look tidy.
Foreign-currency balances and other advances that are not a subscriber receipt and not inventory. Do not take an exchange difference to revenue.

Account Name: Loan repayments in excess of proceeds identified
Description: Repayments recorded in excess of loan proceeds that have been identified. Asset until the proceeds are found. Do not treat the excess as a finance cost.
Header only. Land, work in progress and completed units. Do not post to the header. Do not use Zoho's Inventory Asset for a plot or a house.
Cost of development land not yet released to a sale. Workbook 1210. Release cost to 5020 only when the related land revenue is recognised.
Development expenditure on units not yet completed. Workbook 1220. Do not expense site costs that still belong to a unit.
Completed houses and units not yet handed over. Workbook 1230. Handover releases this cost to 5025. A receipt is not the handover.
Zoho's inventory-module account. Leave it for any item the inventory module tracks. Do not post plot cost, housing cost or development expenditure here.
Header only. Carrying amount is cost less 1590. Do not post to the header. Do not expense a purchase that will be used for more than a year.

Office equipment, site equipment and computers. Workbook 1510. Depreciation is 20 per cent a year, straight line, a full year in the year of purchase. A repair that does not extend life goes to Repairs and Maintenance, not here.
Zoho sample account. Do not use it for a new purchase. Post new equipment to 1510, and move any opening balance there. Do not depreciate this account as well as 1510.
Motor vehicles and project vehicles. Workbook 1520. Same depreciation rate. Fuel and servicing go to Automobile Expense, not here.
Plant and machinery. Workbook 1530. Same depreciation rate. Hired plant is a cost of sales or a repair, not an asset.
Credit balance. Accumulated depreciation of 1510, 1520 and 1530. Workbook 1590. The charge for the year goes to Depreciation Expense, 6070. Do not debit this account for a purchase.
Header only. Do not post to the header.
Deferred tax asset under IAS 12. Workbook 1610. The company has not been recognising deferred tax. Open this only if that changes. Do not use this for WHT credits or tax paid in advance.
Zoho's only supplier-bill control account. A bill raised in Zoho posts here. Do not create a second account of this type. A journal split, if the face of the statement needs one, goes to 2010.
Header only. Do not post to the header.
Subcontractors and materials not entered as a Zoho bill. Workbook 2010. A subscriber deposit is not a payable.

Account Name: Accrued audit tax and professional fees
Description: Audit, tax and professional fees incurred and not yet billed. Workbook 2030. Do not accrue a fee that has not been agreed.

Account Name: Other accrued expenses and sundry creditors
Description: Other accruals and sundry creditors. Workbook 2040. An unidentified bank payment does not belong here. It belongs in 1180.
Expenses a staff member has incurred and the company has not yet repaid. An advance that has not been spent is Employee Advance, an asset.

Zoho uses this for the difference on an opening balance. It should be nil once the opening trial balance ties to the signed statement of financial position at 31 December 2025. Do not post the year's transactions here.

Subscriber receipts before the plot is allocated or the house is handed over. This is workbook 2020, contract liabilities. Zoho also uses this account for retainers. Do not credit sales from a receipt. Do not put co-ownership here. Do not recognise revenue until Finance records the allocation or the handover.
Header only. Liabilities that are not trade payables and not tax. Do not post to the header.

Investment receipts that are not a sale of land or housing, less returns paid. Added because those receipts are in the sales records and must not become revenue. Never credit 4010, 4020 or 4025 from this account.
A receipt whose nature is not yet known. It waits here, outside profit. Do not credit income so that a month will balance.

Account Name: Amounts due on the company's other accounts
Description: Net amount due on accounts of the company other than the four bank balances in cash. Do not treat a transfer between the company's own banks as this account.
Header only. The charge for each year, less tax payments identified. Not an agreed assessment. Do not post to the header. Credit the levy that applies.
CIT payable. Workbook 2110. Credit from 8010. Do not put TET, the police trust fund levy or NASENI in this account.
Tertiary education tax payable. Workbook 2120. Do not net this against CIT.
Police trust fund levy payable. Workbook 2130. Do not omit it because the amount is small.
NASENI levy payable for a large company. Workbook 2140. Do not charge it for a year in which the company is not large.
Zoho's VAT account. Output less input. Workbook 2150. Do not charge VAT on residential land and housing sales. Do not journal VAT that a tax code has already posted.
WHT deducted from vendors and not yet remitted. Workbook 2160. Do not expense the deduction. The expense is the gross bill. This account is the amount still to be paid over.
Header only. Do not post a subscriber receipt here.

Account Name: Director loan and long-term project funding
Description: Director's loan and other long-term project funding. Workbook 2510. A current account with a director that is not a loan goes to 1175. Interest goes to 7010, not a reduction of the loan without a journal.

Drawn bank facility, where the proceeds have been identified. Home for the interest in 7010. A repayment in excess of proceeds identified goes to 1190, not a debit that drives this account into an unexamined credit.
Header only. Do not post to the header.
Deferred tax liability under IAS 12. Workbook 2610. Open it only if deferred tax is recognised. Current tax does not belong here.
Zoho system account for tag and branch transfers. Leave it alone. Do not use it for an unidentified bank line.
Header only. Retained earnings stays outside this header because Zoho holds that account itself. Do not post profit here. Profit closes to Retained Earnings.

Issued ordinary shares of 1 naira each, to the extent paid. Workbook 3010. The amount recognised is the paid capital. Do not credit this account for a subscriber receipt, and do not credit it for shares that have not been paid.
Debit balance. Unpaid amount on issued shares, deducted from equity under IAS 32. Not a receivable. Do not invoice the shareholder through Accounts Receivable for this balance.
Dividends declared and paid. Debit balance. Closed to retained earnings. Not an expense. Do not post a dividend to Salaries, Director remuneration, or Drawings.
Zoho sample account for an unincorporated owner. Do not use it. This company posts share capital to 3010. Do not put opening retained earnings here.
Zoho sample account for an unincorporated owner. Do not use it. A dividend is 3030. A director's loan movement is 2510 or 1175. Do not post subscriber money here.

Zoho's retained earnings account. Workbook 3020. Profit closes here. Do not journal the year's profit into this account by hand, and do not post dividends straight to it if 3030 is in use. Close 3030 here.
Zoho's opening-balance buffer. It should be nil once the opening trial balance agrees to the signed statement of financial position at 31 December 2025. Do not use it to force a month to balance.

Header only. Estates are Zoho projects, not further accounts: Green City Lantaba, Idobi and Omu-Epe, Green City Ibadan, Heritage Garden, Agbowa, Green Hillside, Pacific Court, Pacific Apartment, Gorge View Court and Baay Foreshore. Do not post to the header. A receipt is not revenue.
Construction and engineering revenue when the related performance is complete. Workbook 4010. Do not use this for a plot sale or a housing handover.

Land revenue when control of an identified plot has transferred, and not above the balance on the customer register. Workbook 4020. A subscriber who is still Paying has not produced revenue. Credit Unearned Revenue.

Housing revenue, and only when handover is recorded. Added because the sales register separates housing from land. The transfer of money is not the handover. Do not let the software recognise this in the background.
Project management and engineering consulting. Workbook 4030. Do not bury a plot sale in this account.
Corner piece, documentation and development charges. They are income of their own, not a silent addition to the plot price. Do not net them against cost of sales.
Zoho sample income account. Do not use it for estate sales. Point items and journals at 4010 to 4040. Do not post a bank receipt here.
Zoho posts an invoice discount here. Leave the account in place. A refund of a subscriber receipt is not a discount. It reverses Unearned Revenue or the sale it relates to.
Zoho sample account for a shipping line on an invoice. Not used for land or housing. Do not post development charges here. Those are 4040.
Zoho sample account for an adjustment line on an invoice. Do not use it as a general income account. Sundry receipts are 4150.
Zoho sample account for a late fee raised on an invoice. A subscriber's next instalment is not a late fee.
Header only. Income that is not a sale of land, housing or construction. Do not post a plot receipt here.
Interest earned on bank balances. A bank charge is not negative interest. It goes to Bank Fees and Charges.
Trading that is not a plot or a house. Kept separate so a trade does not look like a land sale. The related cost goes to 5040, not to land released.
Service income that is not project-management revenue. Do not use this for co-ownership.
Small receipts that have been identified and are income, and are not a sale. If the narration has not been identified, use 2045, not this account.
Zoho sample account. Use 4130, 4140 or 4150 for a receipt you can name. Use this only if none of those fits. Do not use it as a dumping account for the bank feed.
Header only. Do not post to the header. An administrative cost does not belong in this group.

Account Name: Cost of sales - materials and subcontracts
Description: Construction materials and subcontractors released to a contract. Workbook 5010. Do not use this for the cost of a plot.

Account Name: Cost of sales - land and property released
Description: Land cost released when the related land revenue is recognised. Workbook 5020. Do not release cost on a receipt. Release it when 4020 is credited.
Housing cost released when handover is recorded and 4025 is credited. Do not release the cost of a unit that is still in 1220 or 1230.

Account Name: Cost of sales - site labour and equipment hire
Description: Direct site labour and hired equipment. Workbook 5030. Office salaries are 6010, not here.
Purchases for the other trading in 4130. Do not post plot cost here.
Zoho's inventory-module cost account. Leave it for items the inventory module sells. Plot and housing releases go to 5020 and 5025, not here.
Header only. The lines below are the expense note. Do not post to the header. A cost that is still inventory does not belong here.
Staff salaries, wages and allowances. Workbook 6010. Not director remuneration. Director remuneration is 6015. A dividend is not a salary.
Remuneration charged for the directors. Kept apart from staff costs so the related-party note can be tied. Do not post a dividend or a loan repayment here.
Office and site rent. Workbook 6020. A deposit that will be recovered is a prepayment, not rent.

Repairs and maintenance of the office, the site and the equipment. Workbook 6020 includes maintenance with rent. Kept as its own line so a repair is not lost in rent. A cost that extends the life of an asset is capital, not a repair.
Professional, engineering and legal fees. Workbook 6030. Audit and tax advisory fees are 6040. Selling commissions are 6035.
Commissions on land and housing sales. Added because the expense note reports them on their own, and they are too large to bury in professional fees. Do not net a commission against revenue.
Audit and tax advisory fees. Workbook 6040. The tax itself is 8010, not this account.
Bank charges, COT and guarantee fees. Workbook 6050. Interest on a facility is 7010, not a bank charge.
Charges on a company card. The purchase on the card goes to the account for what was bought, not here.
Fuel, servicing and other running costs of vehicles. Workbook 6060. The purchase of a vehicle is 1520.
Business travel other than vehicle running costs. Do not use this for a site transfer of materials.
Lodging while on business travel. Zoho sample account. Staff housing that is part of remuneration is 6010, not lodging.
Depreciation for the year. Workbook 6070. Credit 1590. Twenty per cent, straight line, full year in the year of purchase. Do not post the cost of an asset here.
Impairment of receivables. Workbook 6080. Credit 1130. Do not write off a subscriber deposit. A deposit is a liability, not a receivable.

Refunds that are not a reversal of Unearned Revenue or of a sale. Use this only where the receipt was already income and cannot be reversed there. A refund of a deposit reverses Unearned Revenue. It is not an expense dressed up as one.
General office, security and utilities. Workbook 6090. Do not use this for a cost you can name. The named lines are above it.
Stationery and other office supplies. Equipment that will last more than a year is 1510.
Advertising, marketing and selling events, other than a commission. A selling commission is 6035.
Telephone and mobile charges. A handset that is equipment is 1510.
Internet and software subscriptions, including the Zoho Books subscription itself. The Zoho subscription is the company's cost, not a disbursement on behalf of a subscriber.
Cleaning of the office and the site office. Site labour on a unit under construction is 5030.
Postage and courier. Do not use this for a shipping charge billed to a customer.
Printing, including allocation letters and handover packs. A documentation fee charged to a subscriber is income, 4040, not a reduction of this expense.
Meals and entertainment. Do not use this for a staff allowance that is remuneration.
Discount a vendor gives on a purchase. Zoho's type for this sample account is Expense, so it cannot sit under Cost of sales. A discount given to a subscriber is the Discount account, not this one.
Zoho sample account. Do not use it. An unidentified payment is 1180. An unidentified receipt is 2045. Neither is an expense.
Header only. Do not post a bank charge here.

Account Name: Finance costs - interest and similar charges
Description: Interest and similar charges on borrowings. Workbook 7010. COT and transfer charges are Bank Fees and Charges.
Header only. Do not post to the header.

Current tax for the year: companies income tax, tertiary education tax, the police trust fund levy and NASENI. Workbook 8010. Credit 2110 to 2140 for the levy each amount belongs to. WHT suffered is not tax expense. It is 1150.
Deferred tax charge or credit. Workbook 8020. Use only if deferred tax is recognised. Do not use this for the current-year levy.
Header only. Do not post an operating expense here.
Exchange difference on a foreign-currency balance. Zoho sample account. Do not take an exchange difference to revenue or to a subscriber account.
